notes: Line 321 (leading tabs as shown) sits inside class MavlinkStreamHeartbeat (lines 259-333; next class at 334): the source names the message by its MAVLink C type mavlink_heartbeat_t, the same message the description spells mavlink/HEARTBEAT (mavlink_main.cpp:1649 also names the stream "HEARTBEAT"). mavlink_px4.py:2398 documents the autopilot field as a uint8_t enum — non-spatial, supporting frame=none.
